title: Sir Ronald Ross's Slides under the Microscope
citation: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine Archives, “Sir Ronald Ross's Slides under the Microscope,” Library, Archive & Open Research Services blog, 30 November 2016.
tags: Ronald Ross; malaria; surviving slides; re-examination; staining; oocysts; gametocytes; conservation; object afterlife
note: Object-centred re-examination of Ross's 1890s slide box by LSHTM and malaria/parasitology specialists. The slides remained microscopically legible; the project identified oocysts and gametocytes and documented historical staining, turning a nineteenth-century research collection into a modern diagnostic and material-history object.
